h1: Developer support to keep your product running well
overview: Bring us your list of bugs, outdated packages and small improvements. We triage it together, fix the highest priority items first, update dependencies safely, and test each change before it goes near your live product. You get a short log of what was done and what we suggest doing next. This is a fixed starter round. If you want ongoing monthly support, we quote it separately.

faq: No, this is one fixed round of work. If you want us on call each month, we quote that separately once we have seen your product and how often it needs attention.
Can you support code you did not write?
Yes. We read the code first and follow its style. If something is too risky to change without a bigger rewrite, we tell you plainly and suggest the safer option.
What if an emergency happens after this?
Emergency work is a new request. Send it through the order form or message us, and we confirm the scope and price before we start.
Repository access, a staging environment, and the issue list or screenshots. We never ask for your passwords, and you can remove our access at any time.
